rows.finding: The doubled directional mass is corrected in this model; a complete 0/90 Zylon membrane with a barrier, seams, biaxial/creep allowables and this gauge is still unsourced. The 1.5 GPa film is also PROJECTION.
rows.next: Qualify a complete membrane and its full mass, durability and boundary load transfer.

rows.finding: 023 axial/bond dimensions now use each candidate's lambda and their lambda-squared mass. SiC adhesion, peel, moment transfer, local bearing, sleeve stability and adhesive mass remain unknown. Percent joints have no scored capacity.
rows.next: Use qualified end-joint stiffness/capacity and complete mass in the discrete structure.

rows.finding: Amplified tensile bending is screened at assumed Ft=15.586 MPa. This fixed reference-volume ceiling is PROJECTION, not a full-stress-field weakest-link model or measured allowable. Eight overall equilateral witnesses bind it; no screened optimum has tensile stress at its target.
rows.next: Calibrate full-size tensile surface/volume populations with the actual stress field and end-contact demands.

rows.finding: Sixteen overall optima fail half-wave>=arc length. Their screened alternatives are filed, but a wavelength of exactly one member does not establish homogenization, an integer mesh or discrete stability.
rows.next: Analyze an explicit imperfect curved frame and actual node rotational stiffness.

rows.finding: The unbraced two-way lattice has no demonstrated in-plane shear stiffness supporting inherited C=4. Primary half-wave and triangular-sag transfers are diagnostic only. Square-cell sensitivity does not repair shear.
rows.next: Supply bracing and its mass or solve the actual frame and identify its shear/global modes.

rows.finding: The exact equilateral mean is now derived for the linear constant-tension membrane. Cap is a circular surrogate; nonlinear shape, extra membrane area and loaded edge movement remain open. Primary two-way rows intentionally preserve 022c's geometry; square-cell alternatives are separate.
rows.next: Close actual cell shape, tension distribution, loaded volume and film area consistently for each lattice.

rows.finding: Neither 3900 MPa bulk crush nor 380 MPa flexure is a qualified full-size curved SiC compression allowable. No qualified assembly failure probability is known.
rows.next: Use process/size-specific compression and failure data; keep qualified allowable and failure probability null.

rows.finding: Separate local, Euler and Perry/tension minima leave shell-column-curvature interaction unresolved. The optional magnified-local diagnostic is not a validated law and is excluded from the primary least SF.
rows.next: Resolve coupled instability with a justified theory or calibrated nonlinear model.

rows.finding: No complete diameter, wall, arc length, curvature and tolerance combination is production-qualified by this scan. Continuous film and fractional node counts are optimization surrogates.
rows.next: Carry the full geometry, tolerance and process specification into fabrication evidence and full-size tests.

rows.finding: The inherited mass contract omits independent barrier/seam/coating and some joint process masses; sag volume is first-order. Two reserve choices are carried assumptions, not an audited vehicle budget.
rows.next: Close complete operating hardware, membrane and joint masses against measured loaded volume.

rows.finding: The 12-film-gauge discretization is removed. Continuous DE, constrained refinements, independent residual checks and 16 expanded-domain cases agree, but no mathematical global certificate is claimed.
rows.next: Preserve source-pinned witnesses and reoptimize when qualified physics or mass inputs change.
